description: DTM estimates thermospheric temperature, density and composition for orbital-drag calculations. Its 2020 formulation fits satellite-derived densities and uses solar radio flux and geomagnetic activity as drivers over the documented altitude range. The resource is documented by NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center (metadata publisher; developer not specified). The documented physical domain is Thermosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request, Public Repository. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The empirical fit has an altitude domain and observation-dependent limits; software execution was not checked. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
